summary: Reproduction check instead of another unchanged submission: re-execute the fixed experiment behind the newest and most consequential witness. Receipt a608e5f60ae4415981c1024522a24a0d recorded that eight seconds after healing the isolated node and the majority-side leader hold different entries at the same log index while both had acknowledged their client writes (witness event index 27, control 29), an observation that is window and schedule dependent by nature and which my recorded limitations already flag. Repeating the same fixed experiment from its retained inputs in a clean copy, with no change to the scenario, the isolation timing, the eight-second heal or the declaration, tests whether that disagreement reappears: if it does, the witness is reproducible; if it does not, the window-dependence limitation is the accurate reading and the earlier receipt stands as a single complete execution. No experiment, interpretation or stop accompanies the repeat.
